verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at code.claude.com (HTTP 200), and the Skills docs page is served as agent-readable markdown (skills.md). That markdown page carries a documentation index directing agents to fetch llms.txt. Skills guides on platform.claude.com and the agentskills.io spec are also published as .md files. Missing for 10: a Skills-specific llms.txt (the observed one covers all of Claude Code docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://code.claude.com/llms.txt # Claude Code Docs
